    for j in range(M):

                    z = list(nl)
                    z[y] = turn
                    options.append(tuple(z))
            for o in options:
                if not win(o, 1 - turn):
                    result = True
                    break
            if result:
                break
        memo[key] = result
        return result

    return "Takahashi" if win(init, 0) else "Aoki"
